shortDescription: IBPS PO Syllabus 2026 – Prelims (English, Quant, Reasoning) and Mains with GA, Computer and Descriptive English.
content:
IBPS PO/MT exam has three stages. Syllabus is based on the official CRP notification.

Prelims (100 marks, 60 minutes – sectional timing)

  • English Language – 30 Q / 30 marks
  • Quantitative Aptitude – 35 Q / 35 marks
  • Reasoning Ability – 35 Q / 35 marks

Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer. Prelims is qualifying for Mains shortlist.

Mains – Objective

  • Reasoning & Computer Aptitude
  • General / Economy / Banking Awareness
  • English Language
  • Data Analysis & Interpretation

Mains – Descriptive

English Language (Letter Writing & Essay) – 25 marks, 30 minutes (typed on computer).

Interview

Shortlisted candidates face interview (typically 100 marks). Final score combines Mains + Interview as per IBPS formula.
